posts.name: DeepCell
posts.tagline: Your deadline survival kit for office work
posts.description: Deepcell can help you with deadline tasks that require narrations, calculation and presentation at the same time, such as modeling, sales review, budget forecast and monthly report. DeepCell (both web app and agent plug-in) can create ready-to-use docs, spreadsheets, and slides—with sources and cheat sheets to help you explain. Furthermore, every edit can update related parts. The product is built on a newly designed document format (.deepcell), which is especially designed for system two tasks.

posts.name: Claude Duet
posts.tagline: Proactive agent that understands what needs your attention
posts.description: Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait.

posts.name: Doneas
posts.tagline: A daily accountability call with other entrepreneurs.
posts.description: Doneas helps solo builders stay focused, accountable, and productive. Plan your week every Monday, join a 15-minute daily accountability call with five other builders, and track everything you ship on your public progress page. Plan less. Focus better. Ship more.

posts.name: heal.dev
posts.tagline: Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses
posts.description: Code review catches what’s wrong in a diff. Heal catches what breaks when the app runs. Heal learns how to run your application, builds a production-like sandbox with external services stubbed, then hunts for bugs, performance regressions, and runtime vulnerabilities users would hit. It reproduces every defect before reporting it, so you get real bugs to fix, not a backlog of AI-generated suspicions.

posts.name: Mistral Voxtral 3
posts.tagline: Mistral’s speech models for transcription, TTS and agents
posts.description: Voxtral 3 is Mistral’s new family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, plus a voice agent SDK built on LiveKit. Transcription covers 50+ languages with diarization and context biasing, and realtime transcription runs under 500ms. TTS adapts emotion and pacing, with voice cloning from 30+ minutes of audio. Batch transcription starts at $0.0035 per minute, and the models are available through Mistral’s API.

posts.name: Fastlane 2.0
posts.tagline: Create, launch and scale winning ads with AI
posts.description: Meet Fastlane 2.0 - your next winning ad, on autopilot. What started as a simple AI organic content creation tool now runs your paid marketing end to end. Enter your website and Fastlane learns your brand, researches competitors and finds what's working. It creates high-quality AI video and image ads, runs Meta campaigns and publishes content across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Then it studies results, doubles down on winners and uses those learnings to build smarter campaigns every time.

posts.name: Dadan
posts.tagline: One AI video workspace for recordings, meetings and guides
posts.description: Most teams juggle one tool for async video, another for meeting notes, and a third for how-to docs. Dadan brings all three together, then goes further: make any video interactive with polls, CTAs, and lead forms that turn viewers into signups. Built for sales, marketing, and customer success teams creating demos, onboarding, and training content. Product Hunt offer: 3 months free on PRO with code PRODUCTHUNT

posts.name: Loom Record for agents
posts.tagline: Hit record and hand off to AI, now in the new Loom app
posts.description: Record your screen, a meeting, yourself and now…record for agents. No more typing out prompts to explain what's on your screen to agents. Capture video, audio, and on-screen actions, turning everyday walkthroughs into agent-ready prompts any AI tool can act on. Built natively into the reimagined, faster Loom for Mac app with precision area recording, new cam shapes, filters, backgrounds, and 4K capture by default. Give your AI agents the full picture. Also available in the Chrome extension.

posts.name: CutBay
posts.tagline: AI Video Agent: Turn Anything into Videos via Chat
posts.description: CutBay is an AI video agent that turns anything into videos via chat. Instead of manually editing timelines, users simply describe what they want, and CutBay handles planning, scripting, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and editing. It creates videos from prompts, URLs, docs, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and media assets, then refines them through natural conversation. Professional video creation, as easy as having a conversation.

posts.name: Resend Inboxes
posts.tagline: Create shared inboxes, connect your agents, build workflows
posts.description: The best way to reach humans instead of spam folders. Deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale.

posts.name: Mercury 3
posts.tagline: The diffusion LLM that scaled 40x without slowing down
posts.description: Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion LLM released to date. It outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 while running 4–8x faster at 1,000+ tokens per second.

posts.name: Causo
posts.tagline: Find leads beyond database filters with AI research & MCP
posts.description: Your ideal customers don't always fit into database filters. Describe what you're looking for in plain English, and Causo investigates public sources to find companies worth pursuing, with evidence behind each match. Dig deeper in Causo's chat or run the same research in ChatGPT and Claude through MCP. Once you know who fits and why, Causo helps find decision-makers, verify their emails, and write outreach grounded in that research. Better GTM intelligence. Less slop.

posts.name: Voxelo 3.0
posts.tagline: Phone video to photoreal 3D & JSON-LD in an hour
posts.description: Your products now have two shoppers: people and AI agents. Voxelo turns a three-minute phone video into a photoreal 3D twin in around an hour, and both can read it: interactive 3D, place-in-space AR with nothing to install, AI product and lifestyle imagery, and 2-3x the product attributes of a typical product page, published as JSON-LD. Already have splats? Host 100 free with viewer, AR links, editor and API. New in 3.0: API, analytics, publish to SuperSplat. Captured, not generated.

posts.name: Whiteboard
posts.tagline: the open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
posts.description: Whiteboard is a canvas for thoughtful software development. Critique interactive visualizations, diffs, and agent trajectories, all from one interface.

posts.name: ElevenLabs Realtime Translation
posts.tagline: Turn live speech into translated audio as people talk
posts.description: Eleven Realtime Translation is a streaming voice layer for telecom operators, contact centers and live events. Each person speaks their own language and hears the other in theirs, across 90+ languages. Unlike caption-only tools or stitched STT, LLM and TTS pipelines, it goes from live speech to expressive translated audio over one WebSocket, keeps one consistent voice (library or your own clone), streams captions and transcripts, and lets you tune speed vs accuracy per use case.

posts.name: Radaric
posts.tagline: AI feed reader that learns your editorial taste
posts.description: Bring RSS, Telegram, X and YouTube into a feed that learns from what you approve, reject and explain. Repeating coverage of the same event goes into one story with original links. Built by a newsletter editor. From $9/mo.

posts.name: Bits
posts.tagline: An open-source personal agent that gets you things done
posts.description: Bits is a personal agent that runs on your own machine and never sleeps. A small background daemon does the work: routines wake it on a schedule, and tasks keep going when the app is closed. Every step is saved, so a crash just resumes. Memory lives in plain Markdown files you can read and edit. Risky actions pass the Sentinel, a reviewer that only trusts your own words. It answers with live cards and mini-apps, talks by voice, opens with ⌥Space, and works with any model, including local ones.

posts.name: Kugel Ear
posts.tagline: Speech-to-text that only asks when it's unsure
posts.description: Speech-to-text for voice agents that only asks about the word it's unsure of. Your bot gets that word flagged, with the other spellings it heard, and asks once, like a person would, instead of making callers spell everything. €0.48 per hour.

posts.name: Archivist
posts.tagline: From messy filenames to shareable collections
posts.description: New since our first launch: drop a folder and every image and video gets a name you'd actually search for, in your naming convention – Web, Social, Product, Documentation, AI, or your own built from blocks like date, product and content. Keep files in collections, one per client: Archivist suggests the right one, and collections can fill themselves. Share a collection as one clean link. Try 5 files free, no signup. Mac app coming soon.

posts.name: Playad
posts.tagline: Hire your AI Marketing Team
posts.description: Playad is your AI marketing team. Paid ads on autopilot: it learns your brand, makes the ads, and gets smarter every time. From one chat, research competitors, create image and video ads, launch campaigns, and analyze performance. Schedule recurring checks, creative refreshes, and reports. Playad remembers your brand, experiments, and results to inform what to try next. You stay in control through review and approval. Stop creating. Start deciding.

posts.name: Claire Mail
posts.tagline: Email, calendar and reminders, in one fast app
posts.description: Claire brings Gmail, Google Calendar and Apple Reminders together for Mac and iPhone, with AI that triages your inbox, writes your daily brief and preps your meetings.

posts.name: Teclo
posts.tagline: Mechanical keyboard sounds and a keycap pet for your Mac
posts.description: Teclo sits in your Mac menu bar and plays a mechanical keyboard sound for every key you press, in any app. A keycap pet reacts as you type and powers up when you keep the pace. 10 sound packs. USD 4.99 once, for life, with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Notif
posts.tagline: AI for your Apple Reminders
posts.description: Notif turns your Apple Reminders into actions. Write a note the way you normally would, and Notif adds two things: an Insight (a useful fact or tip for that note) and an Action Button for the next step, like opening a map, a store, a booking page, or the app you already use. Every note is a real Apple Reminder, so it syncs across your devices and works with Siri and widgets. Private notes are encrypted on your iPhone and open with Face ID. Free, no account needed. Pro unlocks unlimited Insights.

posts.name: Sponkly
posts.tagline: Live voice translation for chats, calls, meetings & YouTube
posts.description: Sponkly lets everyone speak their own language. Chat, call or meet with anyone: each person writes, speaks and hears in their language, with live subtitles and a natural translated voice, in 32 languages. The Chrome extension does the same for YouTube, online courses, webinars and Google Meet, Teams and Zoom on the web. Chats are end-to-end encrypted. Free to start on the web, Android and Chrome; iPhone coming soon.

posts.name: Concierge by Juniors AI
posts.tagline: Omni-channel AI-first customer support (6 months free)
posts.description: Juniors AI Concierge is AI-powered customer support for modern teams. Unify WhatsApp, Instagram, email and in-app chat in one workspace, automate repetitive requests with human handover, ask questions about your data in plain English, and track AI and human agent performance. Built on a Bring Your Own Infrastructure model: connect your database, Redis and AI provider keys, and we handle the AI orchestration. Smarter support, full control.

posts.name: Kalender Sync
posts.tagline: Sync your calendars & connect them to ChatGPT, Claude & Co.
posts.description: Keep Google, Outlook, iCloud and supported CalDAV calendars in sync, one-way or two-way. Choose what gets copied: busy only, title and time, or full details. Connect the same calendars to ChatGPT and Claude to check availability, find events and create new ones. Built for people juggling work, personal and client calendars, including GMX, WEB.DE, mailbox.org and kSuite. Set it up in minutes or by simply asking your agent.

posts.name: Agentic CleanSlop
posts.tagline: Authenticate, scan and fix your app from your agent
posts.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Bot or Muse. Your agent authenticates you with Stripe Link (no sign-up, no password), scans your vibe-coded TypeScript/Node.js app for what breaks with real users, then fixes it. More scans? Approve in Link.

posts.name: Tetriz Engg Intelligence + Connectors
posts.tagline: Connect coding sessions to PRs, issues, quality, and ROI
posts.description: Open-source engineering intelligence across GitHub, Jira, and 7 more tools. Understand work complexity, spot likely sources of bugs, and compare AI-assisted work with the rest. Connect coding sessions to delivery and measure ROI with quality factored in.

posts.name: Grigora
posts.tagline: AI website builder with built-in stores and newsletters
posts.description: Grigora helps founders, creators, and small teams build websites with AI and manage them in one place. Describe your idea, refine it through chat, and guide edits with reference images or screenshot annotations. Publish on your own domain with hosting, SSL, and a CDN included. Then manage content, products, orders, and inventory, check SEO and AI search readiness, and send newsletters to your audience. Start with a 14-day free trial.

posts.name: Wishes MCP
posts.tagline: Tell your AI what you love, it goes on your wishlist
posts.description: Wishes MCP connects any AI client to your Wishes wishlist with one URL and OAuth. Tell ChatGPT or Claude what you love, and gift ideas land on your list with store links. Share the list, family books gifts, nobody buys twice. Free.

posts.name: Tessary
posts.tagline: Stop your agents from failing silently in production
posts.description: Tessary is an open-source agent reliability platform. It monitors every production trace, detects failures that sampled evals miss, and investigates the root cause with your agent codebase. It runs cheap, narrow classifiers across every trace. When it detects a recurring issue or change in behaviour, it groups the affected traces into a finding, validates the issue, and investigates what caused it. This keeps monitoring cheap, with deeper analysis reserved for issues that warrant investigation.

posts.name: LLM Test Server
posts.tagline: Your LLM tests, without the provider
posts.description: LLM Test Server is a local, deterministic stand-in for 13 LLM provider APIs. Your app keeps its official SDK and points it at namespaced routes like /openai/v1; answers, tool calls, streams and failures come from fixtures your test sets up. The dashboard shows where every token goes: system prompt, tool schemas, conversation turns, prompt-cache reads and writes. Built forNET and Aspire, and shipped as a Docker image so any stack can use it. Free and open source.

posts.name: DoneThat
posts.tagline: Remote work's missing piece
posts.description: DoneThat automatically tracks work without any manual toggles. Users are in full control and can review, delete, edit anything DoneThat creates. Don, DoneThat's work companion, proactively notifies when you dirft and helps you focus on your goals. Your work gets published in your groups' feeds, so you stay focused, in the loop, and visible without meetings or spyware. It takes 2min to set up and is fully automated after that.

posts.name: Yuki
posts.tagline: Your personal AI assistant for everyday life
posts.description: Meet Yuki, your personal AI assistant for everyday life. Your emails, calendars, tasks, subscriptions, travel plans, and responsibilities are scattered across dozens of apps. Yuki brings them together, surfaces important insights, and helps you stay ahead of what matters. We're building beyond reminders and chatbots, toward an AI assistant that understands your life, anticipates your needs, and takes action on your behalf. Less managing. More living.

posts.name: Kofe Flow for iOS
posts.tagline: A simple Pomodoro timer with distraction blocking
posts.description: Kofe Flow is now on iPhone. Start a timer, block distracting apps and websites, and follow your session from the Lock Screen. Already use it on Mac? Pro keeps the two in sync. The timer, blocking, widgets, and a week of progress are free. Pay once for Pro if you'd like Mac sync and longer history. No subscription.

posts.name: HelpWire
posts.tagline: Remote support that starts from a link, not a setup call
posts.description: Remote support software for IT teams and technicians. Send the end user a link, they run the client app and grant access, and you're in. No account or code on their side. Unattended access when you need the same machine again. Windows, macOS, and Linux.

posts.name: StreamCam 2.0 - OBS Webcam
posts.tagline: Your iPhone as a webcam - 4K, 120fps, no cables!
posts.description: StreamCam 2.0 has been rebuilt from the ground up to improve performance and allow you to stream in 4K, up to 120fps! Still follows the same, hassle-free setup philosophy; no cables, no accounts, no extra software installs... run the app, copy the URL & paste it into OBS and you're good to go!

posts.name: On-Model
posts.tagline: Fashion product photos in bulk, with automatic retouching
posts.description: On-Model turns the product photos fashion brands already have into e-commerce-ready visuals, without a new photoshoot. Four workflows in one studio: flat-lay to on-model, AI packshots (ghost mannequin, flat-lay, white cutout), garment recolor and model swap. Every stitch, print and logo is preserved at pixel level. Batch processing, 4K output and an API for catalogue scale. Used by 50+ fashion brands in 6 countries. Start free with 25 images, no credit card.

posts.name: Feedbacks
posts.tagline: Team and client annotations for developers and AI agents
posts.description: Make website feedback easy for clients. They point, annotate and comment; your developer team and its AI agents get the same screenshots, exact text requests and replay context. Keep the conversation with the work. Free, Apache-2.0 and self-hosted. Start with one Docker command.

posts.name: UGCBloom
posts.tagline: AI agents that run your creator campaigns end to end
posts.description: Enterprise influencer marketing AI agent. You bring the brief and budget; agents source and negotiate with creators in 31 languages, grade every video against your brief and pay creators in 88 currencies. 30% fee, shown upfront. No output, no cost.

posts.name: ValuEdge
posts.tagline: Know your portfolio. See price beside estimated value.
posts.description: ValuEdge brings your portfolio, estimated fair value, and company context together. Explore DCF assumptions and scenarios, follow companies on watchlists, and set Smart Alerts to stay informed.

posts.name: Specio — 450 000 Species, One App
posts.tagline: AI Wildlife Identification for Photographers
posts.description: Meet Specio, the AI-powered wildlife identification app built for photographers. Identify hundreds of species in seconds, automatically tag your photos with scientific and common names, and turn your wildlife shots into a searchable archive. Explore your discoveries through your own Tree of Life, maps, and timelines. Works with Lightroom Classic on Mac and Windows. And unlike cloud-based AI, Specio runs 100% locally. Your photos stay yours. Try it free on 250 photos.

posts.name: Flip Ads
posts.tagline: Advertising on autopilot
posts.description: Paste one link. Flip builds, launches, and continuously optimizes your ad campaigns, with all creatives included (keywords, images, videos). No more complicated dashboards. No expensive agency fees. Just smarter advertising, managed right from WhatsApp.

posts.name: Tegy
posts.tagline: Power up your AI.
posts.description: Tegy is a power-up for the AI you already use. It makes your AI smarter, so you stop babysitting it and get the important work done right. Get it right on pricing, market entry, the key hire, the LOI, the roadmap, and more. Tegy is the on-demand strategy team you need. It tackles hard problems with expert-level analysis, shows its work, and pushes back where a good partner would. Built by ex-MBB consultants, serial founders, and investment fund managers with a decade of experience.

posts.name: Tracium
posts.tagline: Open-source, OpenTelemetry observability for LLMs
posts.description: Tracium is open-source LLM observability built on OpenTelemetry. Point your existing exporter at it, with no code changes, and see cost, latency and errors per model, workflow and customer. Self-host free or use our cloud.

posts.name: Hazelchat
posts.tagline: Build, launch and optimize your own customer‑facing agent
posts.description: Hazelchat is an AI agent for your website. Start with the free Website Question Check: see which likely buying questions your pages answer, with the quoted passage, and which they don't. The agent answers visitors only from content you approve, shows the source and checks numbers, names, dates and links against it. No source? It says so and offers your contact option. WordPress, Webflow, Framer, Wix, Joomla or one script tag. Free plan: 50 answers a month, no card.

posts.name: Trfyx
posts.tagline: Know where your traffic turns into revenue.
posts.description: Your analytics stack is probably too complicated. Trfyx brings analytics, session replays, funnels, heatmaps, user journeys & revenue attribution into one place. See what users actually do, where they drop off, and what drives revenue — in real time. 🔒 Privacy-first & cookieless 🤖 Bot & AI traffic detection 🛡️ Built-in proxy for ad blockers One script. One dashboard. One source of truth.

posts.name: Rowsend
posts.tagline: Self-hosted email marketing for the users in your database
posts.description: Rowsend is a desktop app for marketing email. It reads your users from your own database (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB or Firebase) with a read-only login and sends through your own SES, Postmark, Mailgun or SMTP account. Credentials stay on your computer. Run the sending service on your own server with one Docker image: unsubscribe pages, hosted images, bounces and scheduled sends while your laptop is closed. You pay once, not per contact.

posts.name: Graphite
posts.tagline: Focused Markdown writing app
posts.description: Graphite is a focused Markdown writing app by AROICE: Focus, Typewriter and Zen modes, Syntax Highlight and Style Check, Authorship that marks what you, AI or a source wrote, Version History, word targets, manuscripts of chapters, and export to Markdown, web pages, Word and PDF. It runs in any modern browser, installs as an app, works offline and needs no account to write. Documents stay in the browser, a folder on your disk or your own Google Drive, as plain Markdown files.

posts.name: BWorlds
posts.tagline: Engineering that never sleeps, for every app
posts.description: You built an app with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0 or Claude Code, and now people depend on it. BWorlds reviews it the way a senior engineer would: security, reliability, data, performance, costs, code quality. Then it watches the app 24/7 and sends you one email each morning with what happened overnight and a fix you paste into the tool you build with. Once you publish, it checks the fix landed. The free plan covers the full audit and monitoring on as many apps as you like. No credit card.

posts.name: IntRpret
posts.tagline: Your AI People Analytics team, Ready to Work
posts.description: IntRpret is your AI people analytics team. Connect any HRMS to access prebuilt KPIs, employee signals and ready-to-use ML models for HR. Ask in plain English to build dashboards, uncover drivers and compare scenarios. Start with complete AI-native suites for workforce planning and organisation design, available out of the box. Build custom skills and use cases tailored to your organisation. Every answer is fully explainable and traceable.

posts.name: Soul Search
posts.tagline: Guided introspection: figure out your next move
posts.description: Should you quit your job to pursue your dream or stay until you build a safety net? Should you leave your bf/gf or give them another chance? Should you buy that house now or wait another year? These are difficult life questions that you should not take advise from someone that does not know you well. Soul Search is a guided 30-60 minutes session to deeply understand who you are on the inside and the situation you are facing, and then offer you a precise advise based the whole picture.

posts.name: BeeDone
posts.tagline: Gamified planner for ADHD brains that hate to-do lists
posts.description: BeeDone turns your to-do list into an RPG built for ADHD brains. Can't decide where to start? Task Roulette picks for you. Stuck on something big? One of 8 AI coaches breaks it into small steps. Every task earns XP, streaks and rewards you choose yourself, so starting feels less like a chore. Plus a Deep Work timer, a routine builder and co-op quests with friends. Free to start on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Android.

posts.name: Limitly
posts.tagline: Your AI limits, one glance up!
posts.description: Limitly: Never get caught off guard by your AI usage limits. Track Claude, Cursor, and Codex usage right from your Mac’s menu bar. Know how much you have left, when your limits reset, and get notified before you run out. 🌱 Fun, interactive themes, 🔔 Usage limit notifications, 🔑 No API keys needed, 🆓 Completely free. Built for people who build with AI. Give it a try!

posts.name: Pin Pal - Version 3
posts.tagline: A clean new tab dashboard with spaces, quick search & sync
posts.description: Pin Pal turns your Chrome new tab into a clean, keyboard-first speed dial. Version 3 brings cross-device Google sync, Spaces to separate Work and Study contexts, Tab Stash to save entire windows, and tab snooze. Organize unlimited shortcuts into custom categories, search saved links instantly with Cmd+K or number keys 1-9, and customize your view with wallpaper blur and dim controls. Works instantly with zero account required, keeping your data private on device.

posts.name: Automation Studio
posts.tagline: Your n8n, native on the Mac. iPhone and iPad are next
posts.description: Automation Studio is a native Mac client for your n8n server, Cloud or self-hosted. Build workflows on a real canvas, run them, watch executions live and see which node failed and why. Your data stays between you and your server. iPhone and iPad very soon.

posts.name: Quizsis
posts.tagline: Turn notes & PDFs into quizzes your students can solve
posts.description: Quizsis turns a topic, notes, a PDF or slide deck, a photo, a web page or a YouTube video into a ready-to-solve quiz in seconds. 7 question types, AI grading, flashcards with spaced repetition, game modes, LMS export, 75+ languages. Free on web, iOS & Android. Teachers share a link and students solve it instantly - no sign-up needed - or use invite-only student links to see who answered.

posts.name: Ensemble by Bhuvam AI
posts.tagline: Your Research & Marketing Co-Pilot
posts.description: Ensemble by BhuvamAI simulates customer journeys step by step. Synthetic shoppers move through your journey simulation, and you see exactly where each one drops off. Then chat with that shopper: ask why they left, what would change their mind, or how they’d react to a new price, creative, or packaging. Use it to decide what to ship next. The beta is built from public shopper reviews, not customer data, and supplements real research. Try it in your browser, no signup.

posts.name: BrightBean Chat
posts.tagline: The open-source ManyChat alternative you host yourself
posts.description: Build chat automation flows once and run them on Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS and email. Visual builder, shared inbox, broadcasts, drip sequences and a REST API. Self-host free with unlimited contacts, or use the hosted version.

posts.name: supahelp
posts.tagline: AI-native support platform for SaaS
posts.description: Scale customer support without a new headcount. Supahelp brings your help center and support workflows into one connected platform built for AI agents to do the support tasks for you. Supa, your built-in AI coworker, answers visitors’ questions from your knowledge base, keeps help articles up to date, and triages support requests before your team opens them. Everything you need to manage support, connected in supahelp.

posts.name: Deeplist - European deep tech
posts.tagline: DB for ambitious European deep tech companies and investors
posts.description: Deeplist follows European deep tech companies and the investors backing them, with funding, founders, investors, news, stats, research and more. It is the living list of ambitious European companies solving the hardest technical problems.

posts.name: Stocks To Buy Now
posts.tagline: Pick fundamentally strong stocks & spot best time to trade
posts.description: Stocks2Buy is a stock screener, portfolio builder, and stock research tool that helps traders and investors find undervalued stocks to buy right now. Build efficient portfolios using the Markowitz model, and time entries and exits more effectively.

posts.name: ts-r: A port of TypeScript to Rust
posts.tagline: TypeScript tooling, rebuilt from scratch in Rust
posts.description: Six TypeScript tools written from scratch in Rust. On excalidraw, ts-r-dev updates the page 8.6 ms after a save (Vite 8: 35 ms) using less than half the memory. Each tool reads your existing config, so you can swap in one at a time.

posts.name: BookmarkPilot 2026
posts.tagline: Find, organize, and revisit your X bookmarks
posts.description: Search your X bookmarks, organize them into collections, and come back to them with Read later. This update adds a reading queue, bulk organization, complete backup and restore, richer media cards, and a refreshed interface. Free, with no separate BookmarkPilot account. Your library is saved in your browser; your bookmarks on X stay unchanged.

posts.name: MailPixel
posts.tagline: Email open tracking with one pixel, no account needed
posts.description: MailPixel creates a hosted email tracking pixel in one click, with no account and no access to your inbox. Paste the pixel into your email and open a private link to see a timestamped timeline of image requests, then pause or delete it anytime. Gmail users can track right in compose with our Chrome extension. Unlike trackers that promise "read receipts", MailPixel is honest: privacy proxies and caching mean an open is a signal, not proof of a read

posts.name: Seclai
posts.tagline: Everything you need around your LLM calls.
posts.description: Your LLM app works in development. Then production hits: silent failures, prompt injection, cost spikes, models get deprecated. Seclai is everything around the LLM call. Every agent run is traced step by step. Governance policies are written in plain English and screen every input and output. Evals run identically locally, in CI, and in production. When something breaks, replay the trace to find the cause. 200+ models on one account, switchable per step. SDKs for Python, JavaScript, Go, and C#.

posts.name: Foldout
posts.tagline: The Operating System for the Super Intelligence era.
posts.description: One agentic all-in-one workspace to find buyers, ship content and close deals. Foldout is a native macOS app that puts the whole go-to-market of a one-person business in one agentic workspace. Prospects, CRM, content, channels and analytics share one database, so a signal found in one place is there everywhere. An AI runs the app for you, by voice or text, on the AI plan you already pay for, and it stops for your approval before it acts. Pay once, own it for life.

posts.name: Revealo
posts.tagline: Digital freelancers: find French B2B clients ahead of others
posts.description: France - Revealo helps digital freelancers in France discover B2B companies worth contacting before opportunities reach crowded job boards. Explore companies you may not know, understand why they stand out through public signals such as hiring and funding, and shortlist the ones you want to approach for your next mission.

posts.name: BeatAlive
posts.tagline: Turn music into living art on your Mac
posts.description: BeatAlive turns the music already playing on your Mac into living light along the edges of your screen. 7 effects, 7 palettes, all in real time. Your work stays front and centre and clicks pass right through. Audio never leaves your Mac. No subscription.

posts.name: Waendr
posts.tagline: Waendr plans your trip. Travelers share the true experience.
posts.description: Type one sentence at waendr.com and get a timed, day-by-day plan: stops verified against Google Places, a route on the map for every day, weather, budget ranges, restaurants that fit your dietary needs, and a visa check for 55 passports. Up to 5 cities and 30 days in one trip, in English or Spanish. Then a feed of real travelers fills in the true experience: clone any shared trip in one tap. First trip plan free; Mexico pays in pesos. Built solo from Mexico City.

posts.name: TranscribeX
posts.tagline: Transcribe meetings on your Mac without a bot or the cloud
posts.description: TranscribeX records and transcribes Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Slack and Discord calls directly on your Mac. No bot joins and nothing is uploaded. Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet, Nemotron and Qwen3 run on-device, with speaker labels, live captions in 30+ languages and AI summaries from a built-in local LLM. It also transcribes any audio or video file, dictates into any app, and has a CLI and MCP server. Free with unlimited transcription; Pro is $39 once, no subscription.

posts.name: EngineForge
posts.tagline: Create your own playable games with AI. No coding needed
posts.description: EngineForge helps anyone turn a game idea into a playable game without coding or learning a game engine. Describe what you want in plain English, and a crew of specialized AI agents helps create gameplay, worlds, interfaces, and effects. With Godot managed inside EngineForge, you can build, play, test, and improve your game in one place. It's game creation for people who love games, not just people who know how to develop them. Now in beta for macOS and Windows.

posts.name: Tracer
posts.tagline: Paper trading and trade journaling for Solana DEXs
posts.description: Paper trading for Solana memecoins on Axiom, GMGN and Terminal (Padre), for beginners and for traders who keep losing. Simulated trades only. Flags revenge entries, size-ups after a loss, losing streaks and fee bleed.

posts.name: Upto
posts.tagline: Every app on your Mac, up to date.
posts.description: Upto puts every app and command-line tool on your Mac in one list, whether it updates through the App Store, Sparkle, Homebrew, TestFlight, Setapp, npm, pipx, uv, or only from a download page. It checks as often as you choose, finds update sources for most apps without one, and notifies you, with a count on the Dock and menu bar. Release notes show in your language, translated on your Mac. Upto verifies every download and installs it in place, one at a time or all at once. No account needed.

posts.name: HLS M3U8 Debug & Demo Player
posts.tagline: Play, inspect, and debug HLS streams in your browser
posts.description: Test M3U8 streams with our web HLS demo player and viewer. Check native HLS playback, preview live streams, and download M3U8 video files.

posts.name: Super Shortcuts
posts.tagline: Context-aware automation keyboard for macOS
posts.description: Hold Caps Lock and a keyboard appears: every shortcut you've bound in the app you're in, on the key it lives on. Press it, it runs. Open an app, press keys, paste a snippet, click a button, run a script: one key each. Shortcuts know which app, site or window you're in, so one key means different things in Gmail and in your CRM. Runs on your Mac, works offline, voice transcribed on-device. For most people it replaces Raycast or Alfred. Free up to 20 shortcuts; Pro $12/month.

posts.name: Fitness Champ
posts.tagline: Gym log, calorie counter & step tracker in one free app
posts.description: Fitness Champ puts your workouts, food and daily activity in one app. Build a plan for your goal and equipment, log sets with a rest timer, and learn form from 1,300+ animated exercise demos. Log meals by barcode or search (Indian staples included), close your Move ring with steps from Apple Health or Health Connect, and track PRs and streaks. No account, no ads, workout logging free. Optional Pro adds AI meal logging from a photo or voice and a weekly AI coach.

posts.name: Daily Goals: Little Victories
posts.tagline: A CBT-inspired tracker to celebrate your small daily wins
posts.description: Unlock Your Daily Potential: Celebrate Little Victories & Build Lasting Wellbeing! In our fast-paced lives, we often overlook the power of small wins. 'Little Victories' is your personal well-being companion, designed to help you recognise and celebrate those daily achievements that fuel your personal growth and mental wellness.

posts.name: TimesheetX
posts.tagline: From client-approved timesheets to Peppol invoices
posts.description: TimesheetX closes the month for consultancies that bill by the hour. Consultants log their time, clients approve it in one click from an email (no account needed), and approved hours become one invoice per client per month, sent over Peppol. VAT is suggested automatically and budgets warn you before an overrun. An optional payroll & HR module covers placed employees in 6 countries (BE, FR, LU, NL, UK, TN). English, French and Dutch. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: snapcn
posts.tagline: Copy-paste Remotion components for product demo videos
posts.description: snapcn is shadcn for videos: 100+ Remotion components (text reveals, device frames, captions, transitions) you install with one command and own. Every component is measured on rendered frames for smooth motion. 46 free and MIT-licensed.

posts.name: UNPWNED Skill Scanner
posts.tagline: Check AI agent skills for risky instructions
posts.description: Check AI agent skills for risky instructions. Free, no signup. Reads text, never runs skills. Building a website too? Verify your domain in UNPWNED for detailed findings and fix guidance on a paid plan. A clean scan is not a safety guarantee.

posts.name: SoberStack
posts.tagline: Sobriety tracking that doesn't erase your progress
posts.description: SoberStack is a free sobriety tracker for iPhone. Track days away from alcohol, porn, vaping or anything else, and build good habits like a morning walk with one tap a day. When an urge hits, log it, see your why, and pick something to do instead. Mark the small behaviours that lead toward a slip and plan what to do after one. A slip doesn't wipe your history. No ads, no social feed. Connect Claude or ChatGPT to ask about your patterns.

posts.name: SkillLens AI
posts.tagline: AI-Powered Resume Analysis and Skill Gap Insights
posts.description: Job hunting is challenging when you're unsure how well your skills match a role. SkillLens AI is designed to make that process clearer. It brings resume analysis, job-description matching, and skill-gap insights into a career-focused experience. Instead of relying on guesswork, job seekers can explore how their qualifications relate to job requirements and identify areas for improvement. Built for students, fresh graduates, and professionals navigating their next career move.

posts.name: Shoptimist
posts.tagline: Curated products from Amazon - handpicked by humans
posts.description: Shoptimist is curated Amazon. Amazon is a great place to shop. It is not a great place to browse. Find the best products on Shoptimist.

posts.name: Neighborhood Intel
posts.tagline: Sourced neighbourhood facts for home buyers in India
posts.description: Click any address in Bengaluru, Delhi, or Pune to see flooding, water supply, power cuts, air quality, schools, crime, and RERA records. Every figure shows its source and date. Where public data can't answer, it says so. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Payout Ratio for Delivery Apps
posts.tagline: See what you keep from every DoorDash & Uber Eats order
posts.description: Free Chrome extension for restaurant owners & operators selling on 3rd Party Apps (like Uber Eats, DoorDash & Grubhub). This extension adds calculated metrics like "payout ratios" and "share of discount" inside DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub merchant portals: on statements, payouts, transactions, campaign and order pages. It runs entirely in your browser. No sign-up, no data collected. The goal is to provide restaurant owners & operators with tools to better understand their 3rd party sales.

posts.name: Travel Datings
posts.tagline: Meet travelers going to the same city on the same dates
posts.description: Going somewhere? Someone else is going there too. Travel Datings matches travelers (18+) heading to the same city on the same dates. Share your trip with a city and your dates, see who will be there, like and match, then chat with one-tap translation in 33 languages. Voice and video call before you meet. Solo or as a couple, with selfie verification, report and block for safety. Free to start on iOS, Android and the web.

posts.name: Mobou
posts.tagline: One shared brain use GPT inside claude or claude inside GPT
posts.description: 🧠 One shared brain. Your AI, working together. GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more share context, tools, and capabilities across Claude Code, Codex, and the Mobou app. Use Codex features from Claude Code and Claude features from Codex. Your models talk to each other, check each other’s work, and pick up where the others leave off. Free beta for Mac.

posts.name: Stayseeker AI
posts.tagline: Find the right home, faster.
posts.description: Stayseeker combs through 100s of listings so you don't have to. Describe your budget, commute, and must-haves in plain language, and get a ranked shortlist with clear reasons for each match so you can spend less time scrolling and more time choosing homes worth a visit.

posts.name: Steer
posts.tagline: A personal page people can talk to, in your voice
posts.description: Steer turns what you know into a page people can talk to. Visitors tap the mic or type and hear you answer out loud, in your own voice, only from what you told it. Built for freelancers, realtors, creators and families. Free to start.

posts.name: Silex: Stop Gambling
posts.tagline: Silex blocks gambling on iPhone, 90 days programm
posts.description: Silex blocks gambling across your whole iPhone — every app and browser — and guides you through a 90-day CBT-based program, an SOS button for urges, and money-kept tracking. No account, no ads, nothing you write leaves your phone.

posts.name: Compare Scales
posts.tagline: Compare scales side by side and hear what changes
posts.description: See what changes when you change a scale. Compare notes, intervals and chord options across multiple scales, spot shared tones, and hear the harmonic differences. Use the comparison to discover a new color for composition, explain a theory idea, or make a progression more intentional. Compare Scales is built for musicians, teachers and songwriters. Use the full app free in your browser, with optional Ad-Free access to remove cross-app recommendations. Also available on Android.

posts.name: Contentrain | Migrate
posts.tagline: Move your WordPress site to Astro and keep what it has built
posts.description: A WordPress site holds years of content, templates and URLs, and moving it usually means rebuilding that by hand. Contentrain Migrate moves your site's content and template structure to a working Astro project. It analyzes your site automatically, shows the scope and one fixed price before you pay, and checks the result against your original. The code is yours, in your GitHub. Manage content in Git, connect another CMS, or use Contentrain Studio.

posts.name: Linden
posts.tagline: Low latency deterministic validation layer for ai agents
posts.description: AI agents can return valid JSON and still make the wrong decision. Linden adds a reliability layer that validates AI outputs against schemas, business rules, and trusted data before they reach downstream systems. Configure your requirements and get clear decisions: ALLOW, HUMAN REVIEW, or BLOCK. Integrate with an API or Python SDK to add validation to your AI workflows.

posts.name: Crowthy
posts.tagline: Always-on AI A/B testing for creator landing pages
posts.description: Install one JS tag and Crowthy proposes AI variations of your sales page, tests them with Thompson Sampling, and attributes real purchases via Hotmart, Kiwify and Eduzz webhooks, so you see which version sells more. English and Brazilian Portuguese.

posts.name: AgentReady
posts.tagline: An open standard for making websites AI-agent-ready
posts.description: AgentReady is a vendor-neutral, open specification for making websites and products usable by AI agents. It covers discoverability, machine-readable content, authentication, APIs, MCP, WebMCP, and agent payments, with practices grounded in research on real agent behavior.

posts.name: DIY
posts.tagline: time for you to do things yourself
posts.description: A tool that reminds you to go out there and try things yourself. You can do it. Well, maybe you can't but that's okay too.

posts.name: Branchscape
posts.tagline: Turn any question into a visual research canvas.
posts.description: Branchscape turns questions into interactive, visual research boards. Explore AI-researched answers with images and sources, branch into follow-up questions, compare discoveries, and organize everything on an infinite canvas. From planning trips to learning new subjects, see how it all connects

posts.name: Triba
posts.tagline: Fast, frictionless bookings that amplify your brand.
posts.description: Why is booking an experience online full of friction, when food and stuff is so easy? Turns out it's not much better behind the scenes, with current tooling separated and convoluted. Triba. Booking software for adventure and experience operators. Customers book on your own site, in your brand, with no Triba logo. Payments, staffing and guide schedules in one place.

posts.name: Canopy & Tide
posts.tagline: Free 3D sleep sounds with no loop point, in your browser
posts.description: Mix rain, storm, ocean, forest, river, wind and singing bowls into your own sleep or focus soundscape. Every sound is synthesized live and placed in 3D, so there's no loop point to hear. Sleep timer, 9 preset mixes. Free, no sign-up, no ads.
